sentences.cn_text: 随着最新一批学生填写本科申请表并权衡各种选择，或许值得思考学位的意义、目的和价值发生了怎样的变化，以及Z世代在开启教育旅程第三阶段之际需要考虑哪些问题。
sentences.en_text: As the latest crop of students pen their undergraduate application form and weigh up their options, it may be worth considering just how the point, purpose and value of a degree has changed and what Generation Z need to consider as they start the third stage of their educational journey.

sentences.cn_text: 千禧一代曾被告知，只要在校表现优异、拿到一个体面的学位，就能一生无忧。
sentences.en_text: Millennials were told that if you did well in school, got a decent degree, you would be set up for life.

sentences.cn_text: 但这一承诺已被证明并不可靠。
sentences.en_text: But that promise has been found wanting.

sentences.cn_text: 随着学位日益普及，其含金量也随之下降。
sentences.en_text: As degrees became universal, they became devalued.

sentences.cn_text: 教育不再是实现社会流动的可靠途径。
sentences.en_text: Education was no longer a secure route of social mobility.

sentences.cn_text: 如今，英国有28%的毕业生从事无需学位的工作，这一比例是经合组织国家平均水平的两倍。
sentences.en_text: Today, 28 percent of graduates in the UK are in non-graduate roles, a percentage which is double the average among OECD countries.

sentences.cn_text: 这并不是说获得学位毫无意义，而是强调学位并非适合所有人，从教室到讲堂的转变并非不可避免的必然选择，此外还有其他路径可供选择。
sentences.en_text: This is not to say that there is no point in getting a degree, but rather stress that a degree is not for everyone, that the switch from classroom to lecture hall is not an inevitable one and that other options are available.

sentences.cn_text: 值得庆幸的是，已有迹象表明这种转变正在发生：Z世代正努力汲取千禧一代前辈的经验教训，尽管父母和教师往往仍固守学位思维。
sentences.en_text: Thankfully, there are signs that this is already happening, with Generation Z seeking to learn from their millennial predecessors, even if parents and teachers tend to be still set in the degree mindset.

sentences.cn_text: 雇主们早已看到雇用中学毕业生的优势：这些人往往比大学毕业生更敬业、更忠诚。
sentences.en_text: Employers have long seen the advantages of hiring school leavers who often prove themselves to be more committed and loyal employees than graduates.

sentences.cn_text: 许多雇主也逐渐意识到，取消某些职位的学位要求同样具有优势。
sentences.en_text: Many too are seeing the advantages of scrapping a degree requirement for certain roles.

sentences.cn_text: 对于那些将攻读学位视为理想途径的人来说，这或许只是他们将获得的众多学位中的第一个。
sentences.en_text: For those for whom a degree is the desired route, consider that this may well be the first of many.

sentences.cn_text: 在这个通才辈出的时代，拥有专业知识或技能才更加有利。
sentences.en_text: In this age of generalists, it pays to have specific knowledge or skills.

sentences.cn_text: 如今研究生的收入比本科生高出40%。
sentences.en_text: Postgraduates now earn 40 percent more than graduates.

sentences.cn_text: 当越来越多的人拥有一个学位时，拥有两个学位便显得更为合理。
sentences.en_text: When more and more of us have a degree, it makes sense to have two.

sentences.cn_text: Z世代不太可能在18岁或21岁就结束教育：他们需要在整个职业生涯中不断提升技能，以保持就业竞争力。
sentences.en_text: It is unlikely that Generation Z will be done with education at 18 or 21: they will need to be constantly upskilling throughout their career to stay employable.

sentences.cn_text: 据估计，由于技术带来的压力、对个人成就感的追求以及对多样化的渴望，这一代人在职业生涯中将为17个不同的雇主工作，并从事五种不同的职业。
sentences.en_text: It has been estimated that this generation, due to the pressures of technology, the wish for personal fulfillment and desire for diversity will work for 17 different employers over the course of their working life and have five different careers.

sentences.cn_text: 教育——而不仅仅是校园中获得的知识——将成为Z世代职业发展轨迹的核心组成部分。
sentences.en_text: Education, and not just knowledge gained on campus, will be a core part of Generation Z’s career trajectory.

sentences.cn_text: 老一辈人常以现在时和第一人称谈论自己的学位：「我是地理学家」或「我是古典学家」。
sentences.en_text: Older generations often talk about their degree in the present and personal tense: ‘I am a geographer’ or ‘I am a classist’.

sentences.cn_text: 他们的子女却绝不会这样说话，似乎早已明白自己的学位不会像从前那样定义他们的身份。
sentences.en_text: Their sons or daughters would never say such a thing; it’s as if they already know that their degree won’t define them in the same way.

sentences.cn_text: 从最后两段可以得出关于Z世代的什么结论？
sentences.en_text: What can be concluded about Generation Z from the last two paragraphs?

sentences.cn_text: 终身学习将定义他们的人生。
sentences.en_text: Lifelong learning will define them.
